titulo: Point the remote at the ceiling

frases.texto: You can point your TV remote at the ceiling, and the channel still changes.
You never aimed at the TV.
The light you can't see hits the white paint and bounces down.
It lands in the little eye on the set, and the channel jumps.
Same trick as a flashlight in a dark room.
The beam hits the ceiling, and the whole room fills.
The first wireless remote was a flashlight too.
It only worked if you hit one corner of the screen.
Miss that corner, and nothing happened.
The app talks to the TV over your wifi.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who still lines the remote up like a dart.
